Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

If you have need of others to fight your battles for you, know that [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName] mercenary fleets are now available for hire. Yes, you heard correctly. If you can meet their prices, the best mercenaries in the galaxy are now willing to fight for you.

texts.zh:
嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！听好了，泥蛮们！

我们的战士们由于闲的实在无聊，已经开始内斗了，死伤无数！不过我们有办法解决……我们决定派我们最厉害的战士们去为泥蛮效命，当然你们必须支付能源！如果你们想要宇宙中最强的佣兵部队支援你们，就赶快行动吧！
texts.en:
HYEEEIIIEEEEEE!!!! Attention, dwamaks!

Our warriors grow bored and cause much trouble! Much fighting with each other, many dead! But we have solution... we send our craziest warriors to fight for dwamaks, in exchange for credits! If you want best mercenaries in galaxy, hurry now before too late!

texts.zh:
全知全能的虚空之母有一条消息给你：

虚空之母已然知晓你所渴望之物，你现在可以雇佣一些我们的佣兵舰队。我们的船员皆为训练有素之士，若能够提供足够的报酬，他们皆会服从于你的命令。

这是一份难以置信的礼物，请不要浪费她的一番好意。
texts.en:
She of the Void has a message for you:

If you so desire, you may now hire some of our fleets as mercenaries. Our crews are disciplined and will obey your instructions, as long as you can meet our prices.

This is an incredible gift that She has bestowed upon you. Do not squander it.

summary.text:
# 劫掠者雇佣舰队 / Marauder mercenaries

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/marauder_events.txt, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt, common/scripted_triggers/02_scripted_triggers_marauders.txt · DLC：Marauders · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

隐藏事件 marauder.85（on_yearly_pulse，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:240；events/marauder_events.txt:4067-4195）：中期开始后，每年检查——存在休眠的劫掠者国家（标记 marauder_1/2/3），尚未宣布过雇佣（mercenaries_available_N）且拥有虚空栖居者（marauder_void_dwelling）飞船。
Hidden marauder.85 runs each year after mid game while some dormant clan still has no mercenary offer and owns a void-dwelling ship.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

随机（30 / 30 / 30 / 80 无事）选一个部落：设标记 mercenaries_available_N，并向与该部落有联系的玩家国发出通知——marauder.86（部落一）、87（部落二）、88（部落三）。各通知只有一个选项“知道了”。每个部落只会宣布一次。
One clan is drawn (30/30/30, 80 nothing); every human empire in contact gets its notice 86 / 87 / 88; each clan announces only once.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 三条通知对应三个不同部落，彼此并行（每年至多一个）。 Three parallel notices, at most one per year.
- 实际雇佣通过劫掠者外交菜单（marauder.20/21/34/37），不在此故事中。 Hiring itself uses the diplomacy menu (not in this story).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 部落一的通知不发给“可汗后裔”起源。 Clan one's notice skips the Heirs of the Khan origin.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：marauder.85-88 与 has_marauder_event 触发器中的菜单列表。
